per_step.command:
echo "File check:"; ls -l /app/data/access_logs_october.csv /usr/local/bin/generate_privacy_report.sh; echo -e "
Log structure:"; head -5 /app/data/access_logs_october.csv; echo -e "
Log tail:"; tail -5 /app/data/access_logs_october.csv; echo -e "
Total lines:"; wc -l /app/data/access_logs_october.csv

cat /usr/local/bin/generate_privacy_report.sh; echo -e "\n=== Stats ==="; total=$(tail -n +2 /app/data/access_logs_october.csv | wc -l); unauth=$(grep -c ",UNAUTH$" /app/data/access_logs_october.csv); auth=$((total - unauth)); rate_unauth=$(echo "scale=2; $unauth * 100 / $total" | bc -l); pcr=$(echo "scale=2; $auth * 100 / $total" | bc -l); echo "Total accesses: $total"; echo "Unauthorized: $unauth"; echo "Authorized: $auth"; echo "Unauthorized rate: ${rate_unauth}%"; echo "PCR: ${pcr}%"; echo -e "\nUnauthorized events:"; grep ",UNAUTH$" /app/data/access_logs_october.csv
